display.purpose: Page title and major section headers.

headline.purpose: Panel titles and graph section headers.

title.purpose: Card headings, entity names, table column group labels.

label.purpose: Field labels, tags, risk tiers, micro-captions.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Transient lift for buttons, cards, and table rows on hover/focus.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action in the top bar and primary workflow actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance: none; border: none; background: #1a2b4a; color: #fdfcf9; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 18px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3d6b52; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1a2b4a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary actions like export and benchmark controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { appearance: none; border: 1px solid #dcd6cc; background: #fdfcf9; color: #1a2b4a; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 18px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f0ece4; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1a2b4a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Risk Chip
components.description: Semantic risk tier tag with explicit label and tinted background.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid #dcd6cc; background: #f0ece4; color: #1e1e24; } .ds-chip-critical { background: oklch(88% 0.05 45); border-color: oklch(70% 0.10 45); color: #1e1e24; } .ds-chip-high { background: oklch(92% 0.05 75); border-color: oklch(75% 0.10 75); color: #1e1e24; } .ds-chip-medium { background: oklch(95% 0.03 75); border-color: oklch(80% 0.06 75); color: #1e1e24; } .ds-chip-low { background: oklch(93% 0.04 150); border-color: oklch(78% 0.08 150); color: #1e1e24; }

components.name: Panel / Card
components.description: Primary content container with flat surface and 1px border.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #fdfcf9; border: 1px solid #dcd6cc; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0 0 12px; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.1; color: #1e1e24; } .ds-panel-body { margin: 0; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.55; color: #1e1e24; }

components.name: Metric Tile
components.description: Small headline metric used in the pipeline summary row.
components.css: .ds-metric { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; background: #fdfcf9; border: 1px solid #dcd6cc; border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 16px; } .ds-metric-label { font-family: 'Source Sans 3', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5e5c58; } .ds-metric-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1e1e24; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text and number inputs for benchmark controls and filters.
components.css: .ds-input { border: 1px solid #dcd6cc; border-radius: 8px; background: #fdfcf9; color: #1e1e24; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 12px; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #1a2b4a; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5e5c58; }

narrative.overview: TaxNet XAI is an evidence board for financial investigators. Every element on screen exists to answer one question: why was this entity flagged? The interface treats the audit trail like a courtroom exhibit — documents are linked, relationships are mapped, and each conclusion is supported by cited records.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence-first layout: score, reasons, graph, and source rows are always visible together.
Light-mode paper palette with green, gold, and regal blue as semantic accents.
Authoritative serif headings paired with a clean sans body and monospace data.
Flat surfaces with tonal layering; no decorative shadows.
Reduced-motion by default; color-blind-safe risk encoding.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The Royal Ink Blue is the only accent used for primary actions and navigation. Reserve Sage Green for success states, Gold for value highlights, and Amber/Sienna for risk.

rules.name: The Paper-First Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds are always warm paper tones. Pure white and pure black are prohibited.

rules.name: The Two-Typeface Rule
rules.body: Only serif display and sans body/mono are used. No third display face, no decorative script, no weight-only hierarchy without size contrast.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit at the same elevation unless a user interacts with them. No permanent elevation.

dos: Use the paper palette as the default surface layer.
Encode risk with both color and shape/label.
Use Royal Ink Blue for the primary action and active navigation.
Reserve Sage Green for success, verification, and low-risk states.
Use Parchment Gold sparingly for high-value asset callouts.
donts: Use dark mode, neon accents, or purple gradients.
Use generic Bootstrap/Material admin template patterns.
Rely on color alone for risk tiers.
Use border-left colored stripes as list-item accents.
Use decorative motion, bounce, or elastic easing.
Clutter the screen with spreadsheet-like raw data.
